scope: Independent mathematical and hypothesis review of the uniform flat codimension-one proof and its stated rank-twelve application. The parent performs the separate finite-checker audit. No unrestricted density theorem is claimed.

mathematical_checks.actual_root_hypotheses: S need only be actual nonnegative, real, self-adjoint and Markov on the original uniform law. B=S^2 is PSD and Markov; K_x-Pi is PSD even with additional stationary modes. No PSD assumption on S itself or commutation of S with Q is used.
mathematical_checks.projection: For every sign function f, E f^2=1. The original-law relative identity is n delta_ab, so Q=I-f tensor f is an orthogonal projection of rank n-1 with diagonal n-1. Neither centering nor an eigenvector condition on f is needed.
mathematical_checks.original_uniform_expansion: The signs cancel in each triangle expansion term. Under four original factors n^-1, the three-identity term is n L, each of the three two-identity terms is L, each one-identity term is the relevant tr(B^(s+t)), and the empty term is 1. Thus J=(n-3)L+tau_xy+tau_xz+tau_yz-1 with the stated coefficients.
mathematical_checks.Schur_pairing: K_y circ K_z is a PSD kernel by the Schur product theorem. Its original Hilbert-Schmidt pairing with K_x-Pi is nonnegative. Consequently L>=E K_y K_z=tr(B^(y+z)). This uses a pairing of two PSD operators only; entrywise and operator multiplication remain distinct. Permuting the three exponent positions gives L>=max tau.
mathematical_checks.quantitative_bound: For n>=3 the coefficient n-3 is nonnegative. Substituting L>=1+max(tau-1) into the exact expansion gives the displayed rank n-1 lower bound and surplus. Every tau>=1 by the complete original-law spectrum, including zeros and extra eigenvalue-one modes.
mathematical_checks.equality_and_small_sizes: For n>=3 equality J=n-1 forces each positive-power trace to equal 1, so B=Pi and, by self-adjointness of S, S=Pi. Conversely refresh gives equality. For n=2 the normalized complement vector has absolute entries 1, so the one-dimensional actual fields are identically 1 and J=1. For n=1 Q=0 and J=0. Disconnected roots introduce no equality exception.
mathematical_checks.rank_twelve_root: The uniform path transition P0 has holding at least 31/32, symmetric Markov rows, and adjacent transition 1/64. Refresh by delta=1/1024 gives S>=delta. The relative Q diagonal is 12 and off-diagonal absolute value is 1. Alpha=1/24576 therefore gives |alpha Q|<=delta/2. Original sign averaging proves the 26-state T is self-adjoint Markov. Its minimum is delta-alpha=23/24576 and its maximum is 13*(1023/1024)*(63/64)+1/1024+12/24576=837933/65536; thus the stated p and W satisfy the exact original row normalization and 0<W<=1.
mathematical_checks.noncentral_and_noncommuting: E f=1/13, so Q1=1-f/13 is neither zero nor one. At state 0, (P0 f)_0=31/32; at state 1, (P0 f)_1=-15/16. For the refreshed root the relative (SQ-QS)(0,1) is (1023/1024)/32+2/(1024*13)>0. Three distinct states have Q triangle product -1.
mathematical_checks.spectrum_and_zeros: A holding probability at least 31/32 gives spectrum P0 in [15/16,1]. The irreducible symmetric tridiagonal path has simple spectrum, so exactly twelve distinct centered values lie below 1. Refresh scales them by 1023/1024 and squaring preserves distinctness because they are positive. The sign-odd sector is alpha Q, with alpha of multiplicity twelve and zero of multiplicity one. Its square adds beta and zero, distinct from all twelve coarse centered values. The entire centered square spectrum therefore has fourteen distinct values, including zero.
mathematical_checks.cap_and_cubic_obstruction: For the actual compressed M1(0), the state-zero positive rank-one summand gives lambda_max>=12*(P^2)_00. Since P_00>(31/32), this is greater than 12*(31/32)^2>10>4+4 sqrt(2). Thus the uniform first-source cap fails. Also M1(0) is PSD on dimension twelve, so X=M1(0)-I has all eigenvalues >=-1 and one >9. It follows directly that tr(X^3)>9^3-11=718>0; vanishing cubic sources cannot hold.
mathematical_checks.coarse_TP2_input: For ordered row and column pairs of a nonnegative tridiagonal kernel, a nonzero crossed product forces the same adjacent principal pair. Here diagonal holding products exceed adjacent off-diagonal products, so S0 is TP2. There are binom(13,2)^2=6084 minors. S0 and Pi are Markov in the same original uniform law; weighted Cauchy--Binet and the named common-order convex-TP2 theorem put every S^(2n) in the required class and give F_coarse>=1 for every six positive exponents. No claim that the refresh mixture itself is TP2 is made.
mathematical_checks.fine_transport: Original pi/2 sign averaging makes the even sector S and the odd sector alpha Q, so T^(2j)=S^(2j)+sigma*tau*beta^j Q for every positive integer j. The four original vertex signs retain exactly the empty subset and seven K4 cycles. Four triangle terms are the stars proved here, each >=12; the three quadrilateral terms use the named prior arbitrary-projection lemma, each >=12. Hence F_fine>=F_coarse+12 sum_cycles beta^(sum exponents)>=1+12 sum_cycles beta^(sum exponents)>1.
mathematical_checks.scope_boundary: The new star theorem requires uniform original law and a rank-one flat sign complement Q=I-f tensor f. Its all-rank conclusion does not cover arbitrary projections or arbitrary weighted laws. The full all-exponent density application additionally uses the explicitly verified coarse convex-TP2 host and actual binary-channel root.
